title: अभ्यास
caption: वह अपनी दुकान में माहिर है, पर अगले बड़े फ़ैसले को लेकर घबराया हुआ है। बिलाल पहले अभ्यास करता है। संस्थापक उसकी कहानी सुनाते हैं।
linkedin_text:
Every shop owner has a big decision coming and one chance to get it right.

ScoreMyBiz has a Business Decision Game: pick the type of business closest to yours and make fourteen days of choices, from buying stock to hiring, and see how each one plays out. It is practice, not advice. The founder character tells Bilal's story; every screen is the real app.

cast.bilal: Bilal, a young Indian electronics shop owner with a trimmed beard, a grey t-shirt and a shop apron

scenes.clip: the founder, a young Indian man with a short beard in a navy suit and striped tie, facing the camera in a bright electronics shop with phones and gadgets on shelves behind him, an easy smile.
